admissions.purpose: Canonical Heim-PC audio configuration, recording, playback, instruments and experimental music systems
admissions.truthAuthority: Systemkatalog owns stable product identity; heimgewebe/audio owns repository content and live audio tools own runtime observations.
operatingDependencies: physically connected audio and MIDI devices for live operation
admissions.maintenanceBurden: Keep product identity, repository entrypoints and donor boundaries aligned when audio or its hardware contracts change.
admissions.reviewOrRetirementPath: Review when the canonical audio repository changes; retire only after a replacement product and preserved donor provenance are evidenced.
